'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Nahel Merzouk protests]]
**[[Riot]]s continue across [[France]]. More than 1,300 people have been arrested, and 79 police officers have been injured. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-66073728 (BBC News)]
**[[Looter]]s raid a [[gun shop]] in [[Marseille]], stealing eight hunting [[rifle]]s and [[ammunition]] before [[Law enforcement in France|police]] intervene. [https://news.sky.com/story/france-suspends-all-bus-and-tram-services-amid-riots-over-police-shooting-12912490 (Sky News)]
**[[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] cancels a [[state visit]] to [[Germany]], which would have been the first state visit in 23 years. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/nahel-buried-france-macron-cancels-germany-state-visit-riots/ (CBS News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Western North America heat wave]]
**Authorities announce that more than 100 people have died across [[Mexico]] as a result of two weeks of heat waves in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/heat-wave-mexico-leaves-least-100-dead-authorities-say-2023-06-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Buldhana bus accident]]
**At least 25 people are killed when a wedding bus crashes and catches fire in [[Buldhana district]], [[Maharashtra]], [[India]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/07/01/asia/bus-burst-into-flames-india-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*Eight people are killed after a fire breaks out in an under-repair nightclub in [[Phnom Penh]], [[Cambodia]]. [https://www.shine.cn/news/world/2307022043/ (Shine)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Four people are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Mississauga]], [[Ontario]], [[Canada]]. [https://globalnews.ca/news/9807353/mississauga-commercial-industrial-plaza-shooting-prp/ (Global News)]
'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 East Timorese parliamentary election]]
**[[Xanana Gusmão]] is sworn in as [[prime minister of East Timor]]. [https://apnews.com/article/east-timor-prime-minister-gusmao-9d3f254834da006a71e1597f361a33a5 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[European Space Agency Science Programme]]
**The [[European Space Agency]] successfully launches the [[Euclid (space telescope)|Euclid]] [[space telescope]] to study [[dark matter]] and [[dark energy]] at the second [[Lagrange point]], 1.5 million kilometers from Earth. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/spotlight/07/02/23/euclid-space-telescope-launches-to-target-universes-dark-mysteries (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
